meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 它从 channels 分支拷入 Telegram 适配器、配对与 markdown 处理助手及其测试,注册适配器、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试,再引导你创建机器人、保存 token、重启服务,用 4 位码完成配对。
howto.when: 当你要给项目接入 Telegram 机器人通道,或走到 /setup、/init-first-agent、/manage-channels 的通道接线环节时运行。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目接入 Telegram 通道
say.note: 它会拷入适配器、装依赖并跑构建和测试。

say.text: 用 Telegram 连接这个 agent
开始 Telegram 配对,把 4 位验证码发给我
say.note: 它打印一个 4 位码,你发给机器人即可绑定会话。

howto.what_en: It copies the Telegram adapter, pairing and markdown helpers plus their tests from the channels branch, registers the adapter, installs the pinned package, builds and tests, then guides bot creation, token storage and 4-digit pairing.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Telegram bot channel to the project, or during the channel-wiring step of /setup, /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram channel to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, runs build and test.
Walks through BotFather creation and stores the token.

say_en.text: Start Telegram pairing and show me the 4-digit code
say_en.note: Prints a code you send to the bot to link your chat.
